name: SNMP service responds to default 'public' community
description: The SNMP agent responds to a v2c GET against the 'public' community string. RFC 1908 documents 'public' as the example default; modern guidance (e.g. NIST SP 800-123) treats any production SNMP service that still accepts 'public' as a misconfiguration because the community string is the only authentication on v1 / v2c. (Phase D runtime executes this rule once the SNMP probe and credential model ship — schema-only today.)
